texts.preamble: Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025 Author: Soumitra Saikia Bench: Soumitra Saikia Page No.# 1/4 Gahc010083502025 undefined THE GAUHATI HIGH COURT (HIGH COURT OF ASSAM, NAGALAND, MIZORAM AND ARUNACHAL PRADESH) Case No. : WP(C)/2135/2025 PANKAJ KAKOTY PRESENTLY HOLDING THE POST OF INSPECTOR OF DRUGS, HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT, ASSAM, SON OF LATE KAMAL KAKOTY RESIDING AT RUKMINI NAGAR, HOUSE NO.8, BALIBAT, DISPUR, P.S. DISPUR, DIST. KAMRUP (METRO), ASSAM VERSUS THE STATE OF ASSAM AND 6 ORS. REPRESENTED BY THE COMMISSIONER AND SECRETARY TO THE GOVT. OF ASSAM, HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT, DISPUR, GUWAHATI-06. 2:THE COMMISSIONER AND SECRETARY TO THE GOVERNMENT OF ASSAM HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT DISPUR GUWAHATI-06. 3:THE COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY ANDDRUG ADMINISTRATION ASSAM BANPHOL PATH Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128758919/ 1 GUWAHATI-06 4:THE COMMISSIONER AND SECRETARY TO THE GOVERNMENT OF ASSAM Page No.# 2/4 DEPARTMENT OF PERSONNEL PERSONNEL (B) DISPUR GUWAHATI-06. 5:THE PRINCIPAL SECRETARY TO THE GOVERNMENT OF ASSAM FINANCE DEPARTMENT DISPUR GUWAHATI-06.
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner putting to challenge the impugned order dated 11.04.2025 passed by the respondent No.1 whereby the Page No. # 3/4 claim of the petitioner for regularization in his post as Inspector of Drugs under the Department of Health and Family Welfare was rejected. It is submitted that by the impugned order rejecting the claim for regularization the petitioner's services will cease to continue as orders for further extension of his services will not be Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128758919/ 2 issued by the Department. It is submitted that by judgment and order dated 24.11.2023 passed in the earlier writ petition being No. WP(C) No.3383/2015 and WP(C) No. 2812/2017 filed by the petitioner, the claim of regularization which was rejected earlier by the department came to be interfered with and the matter was remanded back to the department for a fresh consideration. However, by the impugned order the authorities proceeded to pass similar orders rejecting the claim of the petitioner on the same ground.
texts.arguments: It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.
